title: Religious Persecution and Financial Crimes: China’s techniques against Christian pastors should be a warning to business.

title: China Curbs Diesel, Jet Fuel and Gasoline Exports
summary: The PRC is restricting exports of refined products, including diesel, jet fuel, and gasoline, due to dwindling crude oil and refined product inventories.
